initialExam.title: WBPSC WBCS 2026
initialExam.description: West Bengal Civil Service exam for administrative posts in West Bengal state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English, Bengali, GK & Current Affairs, Reasoning, Math. Mains: Compulsory + Optional papers. Personality Test.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 200Q, 200 marks, 2.5 hours. Mains: Multiple papers. Personality Test: 200 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Personality Test → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: BDO, DSP, and other WB state civil service posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: BDO → SDO → ADM → DM level through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit psc.wb.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, State benefits
